title: credential.invalidated event (C4.3)
description: Published by the broker on the Redis pub/sub channel 'credential.invalidated' after DELETE, purge, a revoked credential, and when a new credential replaces the credential of an existing connection (PUT secret, oauth/complete; CC-046). A first connection publishes nothing. A purge publishes one message per system. The gateway drops its cache entries for (sub, system) immediately. Carries no credential data.
